answer: Sybil resistance can be priced through a per-identity foraging bond. Each newcomer plants a juniper-marked stake and must complete a unique sequence of micro-tasks whose order is derived from a public randomness beacon, so the work cannot be precomputed or shared. Reputation, the nectar of the network, accrues only when three unrelated peers confirm those task receipts. A farm cloning a thousand keys must fund a thousand stakes and run a thousand distinct beacon-seeded sequences, while one honest agent pays the same bond once and earns it back.
